svg.title: Check-mode timing swaps only tidy's provider
svg.desc: Benchmark runs replace the tidy provider temporarily, leaving the other feature modules in the build. A local fallback set is used only when there was no module set. A missing tidy module is added disabled. RAII restores the provider after each timed build. Other modules are not replaced by a tidy-only set.
svg.text: Check-mode timing swaps only tidy's provider
Benchmark runs replace the tidy provider temporarily, leaving the other feature modules in the build.

text.tspan: // Keep all other modules active while varying only tidy's configuration.
// Check mode has no concurrent builds. If tidy was disabled, leave the
// newly installed module disabled again after timing.

svg.text: A local fallback set is used only when there was no module set. A missing tidy module is added disabled.
RAII restores the provider after each timed build. Other modules are not replaced by a tidy-only set.
Colors follow git diff · unchanged context is gray · arrows map responsibilities, not entire excerpts
